description: Source code for ContactsHandler, including data classes, interface, and implementation for managing contacts on Android devices, with functions to search and add contacts, handle permissions, and parse JSON requests.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact with its details such as name, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Contains search query and limit parameters for searching contacts.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Contains fields for adding a new contact, including names, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking permissions, searching, and adding contacts.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of ContactsDataSource that interacts with Android's ContactsProvider to read and write contacts.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main class providing methods to handle contacts search and add requests, interfacing with the data source and handling JSON parsing.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has read contacts permission.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has write contacts permission.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for contacts based on the request parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact based on the request data.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Handles the search contacts request, checking permissions, parsing JSON, and returning results.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new contact, including permission checks, JSON parsing, and calling the data source.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Converts a ContactRecord into a JSON object for output.
